name: hv15_vm_cal_u-u1-COMMIT
purpose: ONE VM calendar master hfd_hgi_vm_calendar for SW/SE/NW/NE (dedupe, replaces 4 closed per-quadrant masters): universal programme layout (per-field max width, W=187), compiler programme SRAM 1024x256 drives VM slots/LG/ring/replay on fixed cycles; structural fix of the native capture FAIL (rst_n 229-268 ps > 190: async reset fanned to ~90 flops) = local 2-flop reset synchroniser, rst_n pin load 2 flops; 0 normal cycles.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; hfd_hgi_vm_calendar u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/hfd_hgi_vm_calendar.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_calendar_static.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hv15_vm_cal_u/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hv15_vm_cal_u/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hv15_vm_cal_u --out {RUN}/record/views/hfd_hgi_vm_calendar --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
